prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE new illustrated anime ultimate-attack cut-in portrait for the Magic Drink side-scrolling game, isolated on a genuinely transparent background.
Input image 1 is the canonical identity and costume reference only. Preserve this exact character Hexy: vivid flowing pink hair, large magenta eyes, navy floppy witch hat with one yellow five-point star, white sailor blouse with navy collar and sleeve cuffs and red chest bow. Preserve her cute youthful anime proportions and friendly heroic personality.
Draw a NEW beautiful high-quality WAIST-UP three-quarter portrait, facing and looking toward the RIGHT, preparing a powerful spell with focused determined eyes and a small confident smile. The face should be large, expressive and the focal point. The hair sweeps broadly to the LEFT. Her navy hat including its pointed tip is completely visible. Dynamic shoulders, leaning slightly forward in anticipation.
Show exactly one clearly readable wand-holding hand: the nearer arm bends naturally at its elbow, forearm rises across the lower chest, one closed hand wraps a slender straight dark wand with curled fingers and an opposed thumb, neutral wrist. The wand points diagonally up and right, ending in the familiar golden five-point star to the right of her face. The free arm rests beside her torso and need not show a second hand. Each visible arm has one continuous anatomically correct shoulder-elbow-wrist chain. Prioritize correct simple anatomy. No overlapping hands, extra fingers, extra arms or detached hands.
Clean polished 2D anime game illustration, confident dark ink outlines, rich soft cel shading and crisp highlights, matching the reference character instead of realism or 3D. Tasteful warm magical rim light on the face and pink hair, but no large glow clouds. Strong navy, pink, warm white and gold colors.
Composition: landscape approximately 3:2. Full hat, face, sweeping hair and wand star completely inside the image with transparent padding on top and sides. Waist-up crop at the bottom only. Character fills the canvas; no empty half. This will be placed inside an animated diagonal banner by the game code.
No background, no banner or frame painted into the artwork, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no additional characters, no particles, no spell beam. Single portrait, not a sprite sheet. True transparent alpha background.
